handoff: Approve: an open story PR takes the issue's title at the next sync (tail side action, claimed stories only); review #1's glab draft prefix and failed-retitle findings are fixed. Unit, typecheck and e2e green; 2 minor findings (docs mention, GitLab Draft: edge case).

findings.title: Rename-back of a hand-edited PR title is not in the user docs
findings.detail:
A person who renames an open story PR to something other than the issue's title gets it renamed back at the next remote sync (rule remote.pr_title). The handoff's Notes record this, but docs/ (concepts.md, reference.md) do not. They do not describe the PR body updates either, so this gap is consistent with the existing docs.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optionally add a line in docs/concepts.md saying an open story PR's title and body follow the issue and pr.md.

findings.title: An issue title that starts with a GitLab draft prefix makes a ready MR a draft
findings.detail:
editPullRequestTitle writes the issue title as it is for a non-draft MR. If the issue's title starts with 'Draft:', '[Draft]' or '(Draft)', GitLab marks the MR as a draft. This is an unlikely edge case.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Strip DRAFT_PREFIX from the title before writing it for a ready MR, or leave it as it is.
